Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. RenewCo is planning to renew our subscription and add an additional 4 GPU seats to support an upcoming pilot. I've attached a draft order form (RenewCo_OrderForm_v3_draft.pdf) with the proposed quantities and the commercial terms we discussed.

A few asks from our side:
- Can Redwood accommodate a 12-month commitment with quarterly reporting on usage?
- We need an MSA amendment that clarifies data residency for EU-origin traffic (store logs in EU).
- Procurement prefers if changes to indemnity are minimal; we will flag anything that deviates materially.

Please let me know who on your legal team I should expect redlines from and an estimated turnaround. We need countersignature by May 14 to hit budget cycles.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Infrastructure Procurement
RenewCo Inc

Fwding Alicia's draft — see my notes below for negotiation posture.

=== Rishi notes ===
- Commercial: Accept 12-month term but propose a 10% uplift on list pricing for the additional GPUs in year one. That preserves unit economics for short commitments.
- SLA/credits: Keep standard SLA, but concede a 24-hour response for Severity 2 for Dedicated customers on the addendum.
- Data residency: We can offer EU log retention as an optional add-on; do not bake broad cross-border restrictions into the MSA.
- Indemnity/limitation of liability: Push back on expanding indemnity; if procurement insists, propose capped carve-out limited to IP infringement only.

Soojin/Marissa — please confirm if commercial uplift is acceptable. Sergio, can you prepare the MSA amendment redline focusing on data residency and the order form redline for quantities/pricing?

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Redwood MSA amendment & order form — redlines attached

Alicia / RenewCo team — attaching our redlines: Redwood_MSA_Amendment_v2_redline.docx and RenewCo_AMS_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf. Below are the high-level callouts from Legal & Ops: 

1) Data residency: Proposed addendum language specifies that for EU-origin traffic, logs and telemetry will be retained within EU-hosted storage for a minimum of 180 days. Logs required for security investigations may be replicated to US-hosted analytics with customer consent; we provided a consent clause.
2) Term and termination: We will accept a 12-month fixed term for the order form; the amendment clarifies automatic renewal only with explicit written notice 30 days prior to term end.
3) Pricing uplift: As Rishi noted, additional capacity is priced at list +10% for the initial term; we've reflected pricing tables in the order form redline.
4) Indemnity and liability: We removed proposed broad customer indemnity changes. Redwood proposes maintaining the existing limitation of liability but accepts an IP infringement carve-out (capped to total fees paid in 12 months).
5) Security controls / KMS: We can support Bring-Your-Own-KMS for keys at rest for an enterprise onboarding fee; details captured in Section 4 addendum.

Please review the attached redlines. If RenewCo can accept these changes, we'll prepare a consolidated countersign package and a DocuSign envelope for execution.
